finding: Main allocates a balanced partition with the extra row on rank 0, but both initializers assign all remainder rows to the last rank. At n=513 with four ranks, rank 3 initializes 129 rows into vectors allocated for 128, writing past both distance and path storage. Rank 0 leaves its extra row uninitialized. In addition, the pivot-owner calculation uses rowsPerRank after it has been incremented on rank 0, so ranks can choose different broadcast roots for the same k.
observed_failure: The exclusive hybrid execution reports malloc(): corrupted top size and a segmentation fault, terminating with exit 139 before producing a result.
interpretation: Pre-existing inconsistent partition arithmetic and out-of-bounds writes, consistent with retained heap-corruption output. The timing correction only changes maximum-rank duration reporting. No retry required.
investigation: Static source inspection, original/effective diff, and retained validation output; no new program execution.
